{{Quote|I'm getting a distress signal from the worker camps. Putting it through now, sir.|Homax|<ref name="SWTORsb" />}}
'''Homax''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Communications Officer who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]], he received a distress call from the worker camps and reported it to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Korvan]].
